emails.subject: VW defends Audi’s American investment
emails.excerpt: フォルクスワーゲンはアウディの米国投資が長期的な戦略の一部であり、米国での地域的な足がか
emails.subject_en: VW defends Audi’s American investment
emails.summary_en: Volkswagen defended Audi's potential €4 billion U.S. SUV plant investment as part of its long-term strategy to broaden its regional footprint and reduce exposure to trade barriers, after CFO Arno Antlitz confirmed tariffs will cost VW roughly €2.8 billion this year. The announcement, made at a Trump campaign rally by Audi CEO Gernot Döllner, drew sharp criticism from German politicians, with the far-right AfD citing it as evidence of Germany's declining business climate under Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
emails.summary_ja: フォルクスワーゲンは、アウディによる米国での40億ユーロ規模のSUV工場投資計画について、地域展開を広げ貿易障壁への依存を減らす長期戦略の一環だと擁護した。CFOのアルノ・アントリッツ氏は、関税により今年だけで約28億ユーロのコストが発生すると明らかにした。この投資計画はトランプ氏の選挙集会でアウディのゲルノート・デルナーCEOによって発表され、ドイツの政治家から批判を招き、極右政党AfDはメルツ首相下でのドイツのビジネス環境悪化の証拠だと主張している。

emails.subject: Rising electric car sales complicate auto industry plea for emissions

emails.subject_en: Rising electric car sales complicate auto industry plea for emissions leniency
emails.summary_en: European automakers reported sharp EV sales and order growth in Q3, with Renault up 85%, VW orders up 39%, and EVs now holding nearly 23% of the EU market. The surge arrives just as the EU finalizes 2035 emissions targets, complicating industry arguments for more regulatory flexibility even as automakers warn of job losses without it.
emails.summary_ja: 欧州自動車メーカー各社は第3四半期にEV販売・受注の急増を報告し、ルノーは前年比85%増、フォルクスワーゲンの受注も39%増加、EVはEU市場の約23%を占めるまでになった。この好調な数字は、EUが2035年排出目標を最終調整する時期と重なり、業界が求める規制緩和の根拠を弱める一方、雇用減少への懸念も依然根強い。

emails.summary_en: German automakers are facing mounting pressure in China as local competition intensifies and sales continue to slide, squeezing profits at some of the industry's biggest players. Executives are watching closely as the world's largest car market grows tougher to navigate.
